name: Jessica Smith
source:
[url=/c148156]Mr. Smith[/url]'s daughter makes privilege look effortless. Her polished manner and teasing remarks make it difficult to tell when she is being sincere. Given your history with the Smiths, you have little reason to take her friendliness at face value, but that is not the same as knowing what she wants.
